visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male host with styled black hair and a black-and-white patterned polo shirt stands in a bright indoor room with white walls. He holds a red bag of Doritos Flamin' Hot chips directly toward the camera, speaking with an animated facial expression and moving the bag to emphasize his points. Large yellow and black variety text overlays appear on the screen to the right of his face. (2) The scene cuts to an office environment with desks, computer monitors, and chairs visible in the background. The host's hand enters the frame, offering a single triangular orange chip to a male colleague wearing glasses and a maroon t-shirt. The colleague takes a bite, chews, and expresses a surprised reaction while holding the open snack bag. (3) A female colleague with blonde hair, wearing a grey sweatshirt and glasses on her head, is shown reacting to the spice. She laughs, winces, and appears to cough slightly while holding the red Doritos bag. The host later appears in a split-screen or montage style holding multiple snack bags, including purple Doritos and Lay's Flamin' Hot varieties, smiling and gesturing enthusiastically as promotional text scrolls at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a bright, energetic male voice speaking Traditional Chinese at a rapid pace. A rhythmic pop-style BGM featuring synthesized melodies and a steady electronic beat supports the narration. Occasional plastic rustling sounds are heard as the speaker handles packaging. The overall acoustic environment is clean and professional. (2) A transition is marked by a subtle "whoosh" sound effect, leading to the sound of a crisp chip crunch. A second male voice responds with a lower, calmer tone, followed by melodic laughter from the primary host. Cartoonish "pop" sound effects punctuate the dialogue, emphasizing the humorous reactions of the office colleagues being recorded. (3) High-pitched female laughter and sharp inhalations suggest a reaction to intense spice. The BGM maintains a consistent, upbeat tempo while additional synthesized sound effects like bells and bubbles are layered over the speech. The primary host's voice remains the dominant element, concluding with a clear call to action and a final digital chime effect.
